title: Future Ready: Debt & EMIs
learningGoals: Distinguish between productive debt and consumer debt
Identify hidden costs in 'Empty Interest' / No-Cost EMIs
Explain the long-term impact of credit card interest

teachingScript.teacherLine: EMI stands for Equated Monthly Installment. It allows you to buy expensive things like a house or a car today and pay over many months.

data.title: Understanding EMI
points: Principal: The original amount you borrowed.
Interest: The 'rent' you pay for using the bank's money.
Tenure: How many months you have to pay back.

teachingScript.teacherLine: A 'Debt Trap' is when you borrow more than you can pay back. Always try to keep your total EMIs below 40% of your take-home salary!

data.title: The Debt Trap Shield
data.takeaway: Never spend money you haven't earned yet on things you don't need!

questionPool.questionText: If you buy a phone for ₹30,000 on a 12-month No-Cost EMI, how much is your monthly EMI?
